title: Broadway Is My Beat
paragraphs: A moody New York police drama following Detective Danny Clover through homicide cases and the people of the Broadway precinct, with the city itself serving as a major part of the atmosphere.
CBS police/crime drama following homicide detective Danny Clover through the Broadway/Times Square district.

The run breaks into several distinct periods: New York Anthony Ross era (February 27, 1949 to May 29, 1949) on [[org|org.8480b75bc0c36e4b|CBS Radio Network]], Hollywood summer era (July 7, 1949 to August 25, 1949) on [[org|org.8480b75bc0c36e4b|CBS Radio Network]], and Hollywood main run (November 5, 1949 to August 1, 1954) on [[org|org.8480b75bc0c36e4b|CBS Radio Network]].

Names that turn up again and again in the surviving run include [[person|larry-thor|Larry Thor]] (performer), Charles Calvert (performer), Elliott Lewis (director, producer, and performer), Alexander Courage (composer, conductor, and arranger), Jack Kruschen (performer), David Friedkin (writer and performer), and Morton Fine (writer).

Across its run, the surviving broadcasts are tied to [[org|org.8480b75bc0c36e4b|CBS Radio Network]], [[org|org.cd82fd99edb39caa|Armed Forces Radio and Television Service]], and [[org|org.4798d1172deaae2c|Armed Forces Radio Service]].

The stories often return to murder and homicide, juvenile crime and vulnerable youth, Manhattan and New York street life, Broadway, theater and nightlife, robbery and theft, and suicide and staged suicide.

The show also sits in a wider radio history that includes Broadway and Times Square as dramatic environment, Hollywood production of a New York police drama, Postwar urban police drama, and CBS utility and summer-replacement scheduling.

If you are following the same actors and creative circles, related programs worth opening next include [[show|lux-radio-theatre|Lux Radio Theatre]], [[show|yours-truly-johnny-dollar|Yours Truly, Johnny Dollar]], [[show|escape|Escape]], [[show|the-whistler|The Whistler]], and [[show|screen-directors-playhouse|Screen Directors Playhouse]].
